aboutSubheading: Local, reliable & passionate about your garden
aboutText: With 15 years of hands-on experience, Moonering Gardens has been Coburg North's trusted partner for residential and commercial gardening services. From routine lawn mowing to full garden overhauls, our experienced professionals deliver quality workmanship every time. We offer transparent pricing with no hidden costs, tailored plans to suit your needs, and specialist NDIS gardening services across Coburg North and Melbourne's north.
servicesSubheading: Expert gardening for every outdoor space
servicesText: From routine maintenance to complete garden transformations, our Coburg North team handles it all. We offer residential, commercial and NDIS gardening services with transparent pricing and reliable scheduling.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Comprehensive garden upkeep including bed maintenance, mulching, weed control and pruning to keep your outdoor space looking its best year-round.

services.title: Lawn Mowing & Cutting
services.desc: Hand mowing, ride-on mowing, brushcutting and slashing for lawns of all sizes across Coburg North and surrounding suburbs.

services.title: Hedging & Weed Control
services.desc: Professional hedging, weed removal and garden bed treatment to maintain clean, healthy and attractive outdoor spaces.

services.title: Rubbish & Graffiti Removal
services.desc: We clear garden debris, green waste and handle graffiti removal so your property stays clean and presentable at all times.

services.title: Irrigation & Watering
services.desc: Irrigation system maintenance, repairs and watering services to keep your lawn and gardens properly hydrated through every season.

services.title: Consultation & Custom Plans
services.desc: Personalised consultations and tailored gardening plans designed around your specific needs, budget and outdoor space requirements.
